tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Daylight is Donner Summit granite (a warm pale gray, not cream); After dark is the TruckeeLights night navy, so the two sister sites read as one family at night.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, event rows, sheets and the filter rail. Snow in Daylight.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Date chips, unselected pills, the venue block inside a sheet. Sits on surface or ground.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines only: card edges, group dividers. Carries no meaning, so it is below 3:1 on purpose.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that mean something: unselected pill and chip outlines, the ghost button, the toggle track. 3.3:1 or better on ground, surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All body text, titles and the wordmark on ground, surface and surface-raised (12:1 or better in both themes). Pine-black in Daylight.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Meta lines (time, town), eyebrows, the land acknowledgement, the Pacific-time note. On ground, surface and surface-raised: 5.5:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: river
tokens.usage: The working accent: links, selected When pills and filter chips, the primary button fill, the focus ring. Truckee River and Donner Lake blue. As text on ground and surface: 5.4:1 Daylight, 7.7:1 After dark; on surface-raised 4.65:1 Daylight.

tokens.name: on-river
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a river fill (selected pill, primary button). 6:1 Daylight, 9:1 After dark.

tokens.name: alpenglow
tokens.usage: The one loud color: the Vibes half of the wordmark, the Share button, the Our-pick mark and the share-card stripe. Use it as a fill with on-alpenglow text, never alone as a small meaning-carrying mark in Daylight (2.8:1 on ground).

tokens.name: on-alpenglow
tokens.usage: Text on an alpenglow fill. 5.1:1 Daylight, 7.7:1 After dark.

tokens.name: alpenglow-ink
tokens.usage: Alpenglow as text: the Vibes half of the wordmark, an Our-pick label. On ground and surface only (5.05:1 and 5.7:1 Daylight; 7.2:1 or better After dark); on surface-raised it is 4.36:1 in Daylight, so use ink there.

tokens.name: pine
tokens.usage: The Free tag text and outline, success notices. On ground and surface 5.7:1 Daylight, 8.6:1 After dark. Pine and alpenglow differ in lightness as well as hue, so they stay distinct for color-blind readers; the tag always carries the word too.

tokens.name: aspen
tokens.usage: Our-pick fill and the featured-row edge. Aspen gold in fall; After dark it is the TruckeeLights gold. Always with on-aspen text; never as text itself in Daylight.

tokens.name: on-aspen
tokens.usage: Text on an aspen fill. 5.9:1 Daylight, 10:1 After dark.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Cancelled events and error text on ground and surface. Carries the word Cancelled or the error message, never color alone.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a bottom sheet on phones.

groups.name: Display (Bricolage Grotesque, Google Fonts; opsz 12..96, wdth 75..100, wght 200..800)

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark, width axis 90. Vibes in alpenglow-ink, Truckee in ink.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The home hook line. 36px on phones.

styles.name: h1
styles.sample: Events in Truckee and North Lake Tahoe

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Sheet and event-page titles, section heads on About.

styles.name: group-head
styles.usage: List group heads (Today, This week, Later) with the count in ink-muted.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every event links back to the organizer, so you always end up at the original page.

styles.name: row-title
styles.sample: Pups + Pints: AARF Fundraiser w/ Live Music
styles.usage: Event row title. Wraps, never truncates.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Time and town under a row title, in ink-muted.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above groups and sheets, in ink-muted.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Listed by Alibi Ale Works · Truckee Chamber of Commerce
styles.usage: Fine print, source attribution, the land acknowledgement.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Free, 21+, Worth the drive, Our pick, Cancelled.

styles.name: date-day
styles.usage: The day number in a date chip, tabular numerals.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a row title and its meta line; tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between pills, chips, rows in a group.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row inner padding (vertical), gap between a date chip and the title.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side gutter, card padding, sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between list groups; between filter sets.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above a page title; around the hero.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section breaks on About and the event page; bottom page padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags (Free, 21+).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Date chips, the venue block, notices.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Event rows, cards, the filter rail, the share card's inner panel.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of a bottom sheet.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: When pills, filter chips, buttons, the toggle.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: A bottom sheet or side panel over the list. Rows and cards use line, not shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The floating Filters button on phones. Nothing else floats.
